ownership_summary: Adrian Hanauer is majority owner (with Hanauer Fútbol, his group with Paul Barry and Lenore Hanauer); Jody Allen for the Paul G. Allen estate (a 25% stake held since the 2009 launch and still unsold as of July 2026), Drew Carey, Peter Tomozawa, the Leiweke and Griffey families and eleven partner families added in 2019 are the other owners. In October 2025 the club hired Moelis & Co. for a strategic capital raise, its first open-market sale of a stake since 2009; no completed deal was found. No institutional investor holds equity in the club itself; Carlyle is the Sounders ownership group's partner in the NWSL's Seattle Reign.
